description: A model that hedges, revising R-4 into a block revise of B-5 and also proposing the same revise as the addition r1, loses the revise to REGEN-002, while r1 is accepted: a revise rejected at the item stage never reaches DUP-004, so it is no earlier item to duplicate, and R-4 still gets the coverage event.
section: IMPL §3.3.6 (REGEN-002; Duplicates; cross-item order), §3.5 step 4 (cross-item checks run only on items that passed the item stage)
